name: PN lifecycle: select, init, confirm, status
notes: One signed transaction. Each later request is built from the callback received for the step before. Spec basis (api/v2.0.0/beckn.yaml): Commitment.resources items require id and quantity; Contract.id is a UUID generated by the PN before /on_confirm; /on_confirm carries a Contract whose status code is ACTIVE, the PN-assigned id and a performance array; /status identifies the contract by the id received in /on_confirm and is answered by /on_status. The seed (--seed) supplies what is node-specific: the commitments to select, the buyer participants, the context bppId/bppUri and how payment is evidenced.
